title: Paul McCartney live: Estadio El Molinón, Gijón | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Estadio El Molinón in Gijón, Spain, on 25 May 2004.

It was the opening show of the 04 Summer Tour, which lasted for 14 dates in May and June 2004.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
